service_name: Solid Waste Management — Collection, C&D Waste, Dead-Animal Removal, Byelaw Enforcement
sub_service: Door-to-door collection, construction & demolition (C&D) waste, dead-animal collection, sanitation-byelaw fines
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, C&D waste dumping, dead animal on public property, uncleaned premises
department: Solid Waste Management Department, Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation
authority: Solid Waste Management Department, AMC; Mobile Sanitation Court
description: AMC's Solid Waste Management Department Brief Note describes the city's SWM operations: roughly 4,100 MT/day of waste generated; door-to-door collection running since 2009 (expanded citywide by 2017); 8 Refuse Transfer Stations (with full addresses) feeding the Pirana and Bopal-Ghuma dump-sites, both under biomining. Construction & Demolition (C&D) waste complaints are routed through the Comprehensive Complaint Redressal System (CCRS) at 155303. Dead-animal collection has a dedicated telephone line (7819862859), staffed 7 AM-11 PM daily. Sanitation is enforced under AMC's Gazette-notified Public Health Byelaws via a 'Mobile Sanitation Court' — as of September 2016 this had disposed 2,25,442 cases and collected Rs. 9.43 Crore in penalties.
procedure: General waste is collected door-to-door on a fixed schedule. C&D waste complaints/pickup requests go through CCRS (155303). Dead animals on public property are reported to the dedicated collection line (7819862859, 7 AM-11 PM daily). Byelaw violations are prosecuted via the Mobile Sanitation Court, which can levy penalties on the spot.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND — this document is an organizational/administrative manual (not a citizen-facing charter) and does not state a numeric complaint-to-resolution timeline.
complaint_channel: CCRS (Comprehensive Complaint Redressal System) — 155303 (for C&D waste)
Dead-animal collection line — 7819862859 (7 AM-11 PM daily)
contact_information: CCRS: 155303 (C&D waste); Dead-animal collection: 7819862859 (7 AM-11 PM daily)
escalation_procedure: Sanitation byelaw violations are prosecuted through AMC's Mobile Sanitation Court under the Gazette-notified Public Health Byelaws — as of Sept 2016 it had disposed 2,25,442 cases and collected Rs. 9.43 Crore in penalties, indicating an actively-run on-the-spot enforcement mechanism rather than a fixed published fine schedule.
escalation_authority: AMC Solid Waste Management Department / Mobile Sanitation Court

faq.question: How do I report construction & demolition (C&D) waste dumping in Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: Call the CCRS (Comprehensive Complaint Redressal System) at 155303.

faq.question: How do I report a dead animal on a public road?
faq.answer: Call the dedicated dead-animal collection line, 7819862859, staffed 7 AM-11 PM daily.

faq.question: Does this document state a numeric complaint-resolution SLA?
faq.answer: No — it is an organizational brief note describing operations and enforcement, not a citizen service-response-time charter.

citizen_guidance: Use CCRS (155303) for construction & demolition waste issues, and the dedicated line (7819862859, 7 AM-11 PM) for dead-animal collection. Sanitation byelaw violations can be penalized on the spot via AMC's Mobile Sanitation Court.
source_title: Solid Waste Management Department — Brief Note

faq.question: Who do I contact if the garbage collection vehicle isn't coming to my door in Ahmedabad?
faq.answer: Register an 'SWM- Door-To-Door Vehicle Not Comming' complaint via AMCCRS: call the 24x7 toll-free number 155303, SMS 'AMCCRS NEW' to 56767, email ccrs@ahmedabadcity.gov.in, use WhatsApp (+91 7567855303), or register online at amccrs.com.

citizen_guidance: For uncollected garbage, uncleaned areas, or other solid-waste issues, register a complaint through AMCCRS (155303 / SMS / email / WhatsApp / online) -- the same general-purpose channel AMC uses for water, drainage, road, and streetlight complaints, with its own dedicated SWM category list.
